# A Fixture Paper on Citations

## Introduction

Paradigms shift when anomalies accumulate.[^1] Lending follows growth.[^2] The same shift recurs.[^3]

Several studies agree.[^4] Trust can be measured.[^5] Networks persist.[^6]

## Discussion

Lindqvist and Berg[^7] argue that lending policy follows growth.
